name: ESP32-C6-DevKitM-1 (MINI-1)
notes: ESP32-C6-DevKitM-1 carries an ESP32-C6-MINI-1(U) module with 4 MB flash inside the chip package, so no external SPI-flash pins are broken out (GPIO24-30 stay internal to the module).
RGB LED on GPIO8 is WS2812-style addressable; reserved=true by default.
BOOT button is wired to GPIO9; strapping direction is owned by the Device DB, so this profile only records the board label.
GPIO16/17 (J3.2/J3.3) drive the on-board USB-to-UART bridge, hence onboardPins. Using uart0 on 16/17 is the intended wiring; any other peripheral there conflicts with the bridge.
USB Serial/JTAG is GPIO12 (D-) / GPIO13 (D+); free for custom USB use only when the USB Type-C port is not routed to the chip.
Board revision is not pinned in the user guide (only ADC multi-point calibration changed after PW-2023-06), so source.version records the documentation channel (latest) instead of a PCB revision.
